title: matelea calcicola
intro: Matelea calcicola, commonly known as the "Coral Vine," is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Matelea calcicola include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Matelea calcicola include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
